title: Opposition leaders criticize DPP, Lai in National Day remarks
summary: Taipei, Oct. 10 (CNA) Kuomintang (KMT) Chairperson Cheng Li-wun (鄭麗文) on Saturday urged voters to help her party win local elections in southern Taiwan, while Taiwan People's Party (TPP) Chairman Huang Kuo-chang (黃國昌) called on President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) to promulgate laws passed by the Legislature.

title: China Youth Corps' designation as KMT-affiliated organization upheld
summary: Taipei, Oct. 9 (CNA) A 2018 ruling by the Ill-gotten Party Assets Settlement Committee (CIPAS) designating the China Youth Corps (CYC) as an "affiliated organization" of the Kuomintang (KMT) was upheld by the Supreme Administrative Court on Thursday.

228 foreign guests to attend 2026 ROC National Day celebrations: MOFA
summary: Taipei, Oct. 8 (CNA) A total of 228 foreign guests will take part in 2026 Republic of China (Taiwan) National Day celebrations, including King Mswati III of Taiwan's sole African ally Eswatini and Indiana Lieutenant Governor Micah Beckwith, according to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) on Thursday.
